title: Double Cross scripts
description: How the scripts fit together: Main starts a Game from Net's start message; the Game builds its world with WorldBuilder and Maps, and talks to other browsers only through Net.

components.name: Main
components.responsibility: Input map, the menu and briefing room, starting and ending matches.

components.name: Net (autoload)
components.responsibility: Sessions (relay, ENet, solo), the lobby, and the message layer with its host-only rules.

components.name: Maps (autoload)
components.responsibility: The four maps, their themes, the trap and item tables, and the seeded layout generator.

components.name: Game
components.responsibility: One match: the host's hidden state and rules, and every peer's camera, input and visibility.

components.name: WorldBuilder
components.responsibility: Rooms, walls, doors, lights and furniture from a layout.

components.name: Agent
components.responsibility: One agent: its look, movement, interpolation and animation.

components.name: HUD
components.responsibility: Health, intel, gadgets, traps, minimap, feed, prompts and the end of match.

components.name: SpectatorView
components.responsibility: The grid of live cameras on every surviving agent.

relationships.description: Hosts, joins, practises alone, and listens for the start of a match.
Requests to the host (rq_*), events to everyone (ev_*).
Generates the layout from the match's seed.
Sends its position (net_state) to the others.
